---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_games,
    shortened = yearID %in% shortened_seasons
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| dependson: hr_by_season

ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game, color = shortened)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#2c7fb8", "TRUE" = "#d95f02"),
    labels = c("Other seasons", "Shortened seasons")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home runs per game by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per game",
    color = "Season type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
